sub_graphs.name: State Data Structures
sub_graphs.description: Core data structures that hold all information preserved between transactions. The State contains a main account trie and per-contract storage tries. TransientStorage holds data preserved only within a single transaction across message calls.

invariants.text: There is a distinction between an account that does not exist (None) and EMPTY_ACCOUNT. A non-existent account maps to None in the trie, while EMPTY_ACCOUNT is a valid Account object with zero values.
The main trie is a secured trie (hashed keys) with a default value of None for non-existent accounts.
Each storage trie is a secured trie with a default value of U256(0).
TransientStorage is scoped to a single transaction and is not preserved across transactions.

data_structures.name: State
data_structures.description: Contains all information that is preserved between transactions.

fields.name: _main_trie
fields.description: The main account trie mapping addresses to accounts.

fields.name: _storage_tries
fields.description: Per-contract storage tries mapping storage keys to values.

fields.name: _snapshots
fields.description: Stack of snapshots for nested transaction support.

fields.name: created_accounts
fields.description: Set of accounts created in the current transaction. Used by get_storage_original() and EIP-6780.

data_structures.name: TransientStorage
data_structures.description: Contains all information that is preserved between message calls within a transaction.

fields.name: _snapshots
fields.description: Stack of snapshots for nested transaction support within transient storage.

state_variables.name: EMPTY_ACCOUNT
state_variables.description: Sentinel value representing an empty account. Distinct from a non-existent account (None).

state_variables.name: EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT
state_variables.description: The root hash of an empty trie.

sub_graphs.name: State Lifecycle Management
sub_graphs.description: Functions for managing the lifecycle of the State object, including resource cleanup.

functions.name: close_state
functions.description: Free resources held by the state. Deletes the main trie, storage tries, snapshots, and created_accounts set.

post_conditions.text: All internal trie data structures are deleted from the state object.

state_transitions.description: close_state: State with allocated tries -> State with all trie references removed

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Management (Snapshot/Rollback)
sub_graphs.description: Functions for managing nested state transactions using a snapshot stack. The state root cannot be calculated during a transaction.

invariants.text: Transactions are entirely implicit and can be nested via the snapshots stack.
It is not possible to calculate the state root during a transaction (assert not state._snapshots in state_root/storage_root).
The created_accounts set is cleared when the outermost transaction is committed or rolled back.
Each begin_transaction must be matched by exactly one commit_transaction or rollback_transaction.
Transient storage snapshots are managed in parallel with state snapshots during begin/commit/rollback.

functions.name: begin_transaction
functions.description: Start a state transaction by taking a deep copy snapshot of the main trie and all storage tries, as well as all transient storage tries.

post_conditions.text: A snapshot tuple (copy of _main_trie, copy of all _storage_tries) is appended to state._snapshots.
A snapshot dict (copy of all transient_storage._tries) is appended to transient_storage._snapshots.

functions.name: commit_transaction
functions.description: Commit a state transaction by discarding the most recent snapshot. If outermost, clears created_accounts.

post_conditions.text: The most recent snapshot is removed from state._snapshots.
If state._snapshots is now empty, state.created_accounts is cleared.
The most recent transient storage snapshot is removed.

functions.name: rollback_transaction
functions.description: Rollback a state transaction, resetting the state to the point when begin_transaction() was called.

post_conditions.text: state._main_trie and state._storage_tries are restored from the popped snapshot.
If state._snapshots is now empty, state.created_accounts is cleared.
transient_storage._tries is restored from the popped transient storage snapshot.

state_transitions.description: begin_transaction: Pushes deep copy of (main_trie, storage_tries) onto state._snapshots.
commit_transaction: Pops top snapshot, keeping current state.
rollback_transaction: Pops top snapshot and replaces current tries with snapshot values.

sub_graphs.name: Account CRUD Operations
sub_graphs.description: Functions for creating, reading, updating, and deleting accounts in the state trie.

invariants.text: get_account() always returns a valid Account object (never None). For non-existent accounts, it returns EMPTY_ACCOUNT.
get_account_optional() returns None for non-existent accounts, preserving the distinction between non-existent and empty.
Setting an account to None via set_account removes the account from the trie but does NOT remove its storage.

functions.name: get_account
functions.description: Get the Account object at an address. Returns EMPTY_ACCOUNT if there is no account.

functions.name: get_account_optional
functions.description: Get the Account object at an address. Returns None if there is no account.

functions.name: set_account
functions.signature: set_account(state: State, address: Address, account: Optional[Account]) -> None
functions.description: Set the Account object at an address. Setting to None deletes the account (but not its storage).

functions.name: destroy_account
functions.description: Completely remove the account and all of its storage. Made available for SELFDESTRUCT.

functions.name: destroy_storage
functions.description: Completely remove the storage at an address.

functions.name: mark_account_created
functions.description: Mark an account as having been created in the current transaction. Used by get_storage_original() and EIP-6780.

state_transitions.description: set_account(addr, None): Removes addr from state._main_trie
destroy_account(addr): Removes addr from both _storage_tries and _main_trie

sub_graphs.name: Storage Operations
sub_graphs.description: Functions for reading and writing contract storage slots. Includes both current and original (pre-transaction) storage access.

invariants.text: Storage keys that have not been set return U256(0) as the default value.
Setting a storage value to the trie's default effectively deletes it. When all keys are deleted, the storage trie entry is removed.
set_storage requires that the account exists in the main trie (assertion).
For newly created accounts, get_storage_original returns U256(0) regardless of any preexisting storage.

functions.name: get_storage
functions.signature: get_storage(state: State, address: Address, key: Bytes32) -> U256
functions.description: Get a value at a storage key. Returns U256(0) if not set.

functions.name: set_storage
functions.signature: set_storage(state: State, address: Address, key: Bytes32, value: U256) -> None
functions.description: Set a value at a storage key. Setting to U256(0) deletes the key. Auto-cleans empty tries.

functions.name: get_storage_original
functions.signature: get_storage_original(state: State, address: Address, key: Bytes32) -> U256
functions.description: Get the original value before the current transaction. Reads from outermost snapshot. Returns U256(0) for newly created accounts.

state_transitions.description: set_storage(addr, key, value): Creates or updates _storage_tries[addr][key]. Removes trie if empty.

sub_graphs.name: State and Storage Root Computation
sub_graphs.description: Functions for computing Merkle-Patricia trie roots. Can only be called outside of transactions.

invariants.text: state_root() and storage_root() can only be called when state._snapshots is empty (no active transaction).
An account with no storage trie entry has a storage root equal to EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT.

functions.name: storage_root
functions.description: Calculate the storage root of an account. Returns EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT if no storage.

functions.name: state_root
functions.description: Calculate the state root using storage_root per account.

sub_graphs.name: Account Query Predicates
sub_graphs.description: Boolean query functions for checking various properties of accounts. Pure reads with no side effects.

invariants.text: account_exists checks for non-None (including EMPTY_ACCOUNT).
is_account_alive requires both existence (not None) AND non-emptiness (not EMPTY_ACCOUNT).

functions.name: account_exists
functions.description: Checks if an account exists in the state trie.

functions.name: account_has_code_or_nonce
functions.description: Checks if an account has non-zero nonce or non-empty code.

functions.name: account_has_storage
functions.description: Checks if an account has storage.

functions.name: is_account_alive
functions.description: Check whether an account is both in the state and non-empty.

sub_graphs.name: State Mutation Helpers
sub_graphs.description: Higher-level functions that modify account state through the modify_state pattern with empty-account cleanup.

invariants.text: After any modification via modify_state, if the resulting account has zero nonce, empty code, and zero balance, it is destroyed.
move_ether: The sender must have sufficient balance (sender.balance >= amount).
move_ether: Total ether is conserved -- the amount deducted from sender equals amount added to recipient.

functions.name: modify_state
functions.signature: modify_state(state: State, address: Address, f: Callable[[Account], None]) -> None
functions.description: Modify an Account by applying a callback, then destroy if account becomes empty.

functions.name: move_ether
functions.signature: move_ether(state: State, sender_address: Address, recipient_address: Address, amount: U256) -> None
functions.description: Move funds between accounts. Raises AssertionError if sender has insufficient balance.

functions.name: set_account_balance
functions.signature: set_account_balance(state: State, address: Address, amount: U256) -> None
functions.description: Sets the balance of an account.

functions.name: increment_nonce
functions.description: Increments the nonce of an account by 1.

functions.name: set_code
functions.signature: set_code(state: State, address: Address, code: Bytes) -> None
functions.description: Sets Account code (bytecode).

state_transitions.description: modify_state(addr, f): Applies f to account, then destroys if empty.
move_ether(sender, recipient, amount): sender.balance -= amount, recipient.balance += amount.

sub_graphs.name: Transient Storage Operations
sub_graphs.description: Functions for reading and writing transient storage (EIP-1153). Persists within a single transaction across message calls.

invariants.text: Transient storage keys that have not been set return U256(0).
When all keys for an address are deleted, the address entry is removed from _tries.
Transient storage is entirely separate from permanent storage and does not affect state_root.

functions.name: get_transient_storage
functions.signature: get_transient_storage(transient_storage: TransientStorage, address: Address, key: Bytes32) -> U256
functions.description: Get a value from transient storage. Returns U256(0) if not set.

functions.name: set_transient_storage
functions.signature: set_transient_storage(transient_storage: TransientStorage, address: Address, key: Bytes32, value: U256) -> None
functions.description: Set a value in transient storage. Setting to U256(0) deletes the key. Auto-cleans empty tries.

state_transitions.description: set_transient_storage(addr, key, value): Creates or updates transient_storage._tries[addr][key]. Removes trie if empty.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Gas Cost Constants
sub_graphs.description: Defines the fundamental gas cost constants used across all transaction types.

invariants.text: TX_BASE_COST is always 21000 gas, representing the minimum gas required for any transaction execution.
FLOOR_CALLDATA_COST (10 gas per token, EIP-7623) must always be >= STANDARD_CALLDATA_TOKEN_COST (4 gas per token).
TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT is 16,777,216 (2^24), providing an upper bound on the gas limit for any single transaction.

state_variables.name: TX_BASE_COST
state_variables.description: Base cost of a transaction in gas units.

state_variables.name: FLOOR_CALLDATA_COST
state_variables.description: Minimum gas cost per byte of calldata (EIP-7623).

state_variables.name: STANDARD_CALLDATA_TOKEN_COST
state_variables.description: Gas cost per byte of calldata (EIP-7623).

state_variables.name: TX_CREATE_COST
state_variables.description: Additional gas cost for creating a new contract.

state_variables.name: TX_ACCESS_LIST_ADDRESS_COST
state_variables.description: Gas cost for including an address in the access list.

state_variables.name: TX_ACCESS_LIST_STORAGE_KEY_COST
state_variables.description: Gas cost for including a storage key in the access list.

state_variables.name: TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT
state_variables.description: Maximum gas limit for a single transaction (2^24).

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Type Definitions
sub_graphs.description: Defines the five transaction types supported in the Osaka fork plus the Access helper and Transaction union type.

invariants.text: A Transaction must be exactly one of: LegacyTransaction, AccessListTransaction, FeeMarketTransaction, BlobTransaction, or SetCodeTransaction.
All transaction data structures are slotted_freezable (immutable after creation).
BlobTransaction and SetCodeTransaction require 'to' to be a valid Address (not Bytes0), meaning they cannot be contract creation transactions.

data_structures.name: LegacyTransaction
data_structures.description: Original transaction format used before EIP-1559, EIP-2930, EIP-4844, and EIP-7702.

data_structures.name: Access
data_structures.description: A mapping from account address to storage slots that are pre-warmed.

data_structures.name: AccessListTransaction
data_structures.description: The transaction type added in EIP-2930 to support access lists.

data_structures.name: FeeMarketTransaction
data_structures.description: The transaction type added in EIP-1559.

data_structures.name: BlobTransaction
data_structures.description: The transaction type added in EIP-4844.

data_structures.name: SetCodeTransaction
data_structures.description: The transaction type added in EIP-7702.

data_structures.name: Transaction
data_structures.description: Union type encompassing all five supported transaction types.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Encoding and Decoding
sub_graphs.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of transactions. Type identifiers: 0x01=AccessList, 0x02=FeeMarket, 0x03=Blob, 0x04=SetCode.

invariants.text: encode_transaction and decode_transaction are inverse operations.
Transaction type byte prefixes are unique: 0x01 (AccessList), 0x02 (FeeMarket), 0x03 (Blob), 0x04 (SetCode). Legacy has no prefix.
Legacy transactions are returned as-is by encode_transaction.

functions.name: encode_transaction
functions.description: Encode a transaction into its RLP or typed transaction format.
error_conditions: Raises Exception if tx is not a recognized transaction type.

functions.name: decode_transaction
functions.description: Decode a transaction from its RLP or typed transaction format.
error_conditions: Raises TransactionTypeError if the type byte is not recognized (not 1-4).

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Validation
sub_graphs.description: Validates transactions before execution by checking gas sufficiency, nonce bounds, init code size limits, and per-transaction gas limits. Implements EIP-7623 calldata floor gas cost.

invariants.text: The effective gas requirement is max(intrinsic_gas, calldata_floor_gas_cost), and must not exceed tx.gas.
Transaction nonce must be strictly less than U64.MAX_VALUE (EIP-2681).
Contract creation transactions (to == Bytes0) must have data length not exceeding MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE.
Transaction gas limit must not exceed TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT (16,777,216).

functions.name: validate_transaction
functions.description: Verifies a transaction. Returns (intrinsic_gas_cost, calldata_floor_gas_cost).
error_conditions: Raises InsufficientTransactionGasError if max(intrinsic_gas, calldata_floor_gas_cost) > tx.gas.
Raises InitCodeTooLargeError if contract creation with data exceeding MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE.

functions.name: calculate_intrinsic_cost
functions.description: Calculates intrinsic gas cost. Includes: base cost, calldata cost, create cost, access list cost, authorization cost. Returns (intrinsic_gas_cost, calldata_floor_gas_cost).

computation_details.create_cost: TX_CREATE_COST + init_code_cost(len(tx.data)) if contract creation, else 0
computation_details.access_list_cost: TX_ACCESS_LIST_ADDRESS_COST per address + TX_ACCESS_LIST_STORAGE_KEY_COST per slot

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Signature Recovery
sub_graphs.description: Recovers the sender address from a transaction's ECDSA signature. Each transaction type has its own signing hash computation.

invariants.text: r must be in range (0, SECP256K1N).
s must be in range (0, SECP256K1N / 2] (low-s normalization).
For typed transactions, y_parity must be exactly 0 or 1.
For legacy transactions, v must be 27/28 (pre-EIP-155) or 35+chain_id*2 / 36+chain_id*2 (EIP-155).
Sender address = keccak256(recovered_public_key)[12:32].

functions.name: recover_sender
functions.description: Extracts the sender address from a transaction's signature.

functions.name: signing_hash_pre155
functions.description: Legacy (pre EIP-155) signing hash.

functions.name: signing_hash_155
functions.description: EIP-155 signing hash.

functions.name: signing_hash_2930
functions.description: EIP-2930 signing hash.

functions.name: signing_hash_1559
functions.description: EIP-1559 signing hash.

functions.name: signing_hash_4844
functions.description: EIP-4844 signing hash.

functions.name: signing_hash_7702
functions.description: EIP-7702 signing hash.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Hashing
sub_graphs.description: Computes the unique hash identifier for a transaction.

invariants.text: get_transaction_hash must accept only LegacyTransaction or Bytes inputs.
The transaction hash is deterministic.

functions.name: get_transaction_hash
functions.description: Compute the keccak256 hash of a transaction.

eips.description: Simple replay attack protection via chain_id.
Fee market change with base fee and priority fee.
